youtube.title: This Penguin Is A Major General (True Story) 🐧
youtube.description:
In 1972 the Norwegian King's Guard, in Edinburgh for the Military Tattoo, adopted a king penguin at Edinburgh Zoo, named him Nils Olav and made him a lance corporal. On later visits he was promoted again and again: corporal in 1982, sergeant in 1987, regimental sergeant major in 1993. The first Nils Olav died in 1987, and a lookalike took over the name and the rank; Nils Olav III holds them today.

In 2008 he was knighted with the approval of King Harald V. 130 guardsmen paraded at the zoo, and the citation called him "in every way qualified to receive the honour and dignity of knighthood". A bronze statue of him stands at the zoo. He became a brigadier in 2016 and a major general in 2023.
